title: Sip Account
description: A SIP Account that can be used to make calls via the CM.com Platform.

guid.description: Unique identifier of the SIP Account.

createdOn.description: Date and time on which the SIP Account was created.

customerAccountGuid.description: The unique identifier of the Voice Account which this SIP Account is part of.

name.description: Display name of the SIP Account.

username.description: Username of the SIP Account. The username is generated automatically by CM.com and cannot be changed.

isActive.description: Whether or not the SIP Account is set to active.

inPrison.description: Whether the account has a temporary ban after entering the wrong password too many times.

ApiSipConfig.title: Sip Config

cpsLimit.description: Limit of the amount of calls that can be set up per second.

ccLimit.description: Limit of the amount of calls that can take place concurrently.

alwaysAnonymous.description: Whether or not outbound calls from this SIP Account will always be dialed out with CLI anonymous.

hasAnonymousOverride.description: When set to true, this option guarantees routing that support anonymous calls.

defaultOutboundCallerId.description: The CLI used when making outbound calls. This does not override a valid CLI that is already provided in the SIP invite.

restrictionType.description: Sets the type of prefix restrictions placed on this SIP Account, this can be either set to `whitelist` or `blacklist`. When set to `whitelist`, only calls to the given prefixes will be allowed, when set to `blacklist`, only calls to the given prefixes will be blocked.

primaryTrunkId.description: Platform name or domain of the primary SIP trunk or DNS that will be used. The `/trunks` and `/platformdomains` endpoints can be used to get a list of currently active SIP Trunks and Platform Domains.

secondaryTrunkId.description: Platform name or domain of the secondary (backup) SIP trunk that will be used. The `/trunks` and `/platformdomains` endpoints can be used to get a list of currently active SIP Trunks and Platform Domains. **When using DNS, reach out to support for a backup DNS.**

blockNonEerToEer.description: All calls with a non-European CLI to a European country will be blocked for this SIP account.

allowPremium.description: Allow calls to premium pay-per-minute or pay-per-call numbers.

ApiSipConfig.description: SIP configuration containing settings that define how a SIP Account can be used.
